extraction.name: COMMONSENSE QA
extraction.description: COMMONSENSE QA is a dataset for commonsense question answering containing 12,247 multiple-choice questions. The questions are authored by crowd-workers based on subgraphs extracted from ConceptNet, requiring prior knowledge to discriminate between target concepts.
extraction.creator: Alon Talmor; Jonathan Herzig; Nicholas Lourie; Jonathan Berant
extraction.citeAs: Alon Talmor, Jonathan Herzig, Nicholas Lourie, Jonathan Berant. COMMONSENSE QA: A Question Answering Challenge Targeting Commonsense Knowledge. arXiv:1811.00937v2, 2019.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was assembled by extracting subgraphs from the ConceptNet knowledge base, asking Amazon Mechanical Turk crowd-workers to author multiple-choice questions and distractors based on those subgraphs, and retrieving web snippets via Google search to add textual context.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis; Manual Human Curator; Web Scraping
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The ConceptNet knowledge base and web snippets retrieved from Google search.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: AMT workers were shown a question concept and three answer concepts from ConceptNet and asked to formulate three questions containing the question concept, with each question having one of the answer concepts as the correct answer. Workers were instructed to avoid using words with a strong relation to the answer concept. They also added two distractors per question (one from ConceptNet, one manually authored). A disjoint group of workers then verified the questions by annotating them as unanswerable or choosing the right answer.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Each question was verified by 2 workers who annotated it as unanswerable or chose the right answer. Only questions verified by at least one worker that answered correctly were used, filtering out 15% of the questions.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: commonsense question answering; incorporating commonsense knowledge into NLU systems
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Generated questions were verified by two workers, and only questions where at least one worker answered correctly were retained, filtering out 15% of the questions. Additionally, textual context was added to each question by retrieving the first 100 Google search snippets for each of the five answer candidates.
